statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is needed to correlate clinical events with arrhythmic activity
The service is to capture rhythm data during daily activities
Diagnosis codes R55, I48.0, and I48.91 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
